description: Labelled practitioner prompts for evaluating MCP and model-in-the-loop skill routing. Prompts use natural ticket and developer phrasing without primitive IDs. Negative cases (expected: []) verify the router stays quiet on routine coding edits where no architectural or process skill applies.

cases.prompt: I want to hand this repository to a fresh Claude Code or Replit session tomorrow with zero chat history so it knows the entry point and rules immediately.
The coding session keeps approving its own pull request and missing skipped criteria; set up a second reviewer session that checks the diff against the spec.
Three weeks after launch our markdown spec is already stale and contradicts the codebase; make spec-to-code divergence fail the build automatically.
Document the rationale and rejected trade-offs for choosing Postgres over DynamoDB in an ADR so the next contributor stops proposing a rewrite.
Freeze the OpenAPI endpoint schemas, HTTP status codes and JSON error envelope before the backend and mobile engineers start coding separately.
The agent started writing custom password-reset emails and credit-card tokenization from scratch instead of picking proven auth and payment provider vendors.
Add an automated boundary check or import rule in CI that fails whenever code inside src/domain imports Express or database drivers.
Isolate our core pricing logic behind narrow ports and adapters so we can swap Postgres or S3 in tests without vendor lock-in.
Two developers want to split a brand-new MVP into seven microservices with Kafka; keep a modular monolith layout until a measured bottleneck justifies splitting.
Customers in the EU need a self-serve data export and complete GDPR account deletion with a 30-day PII retention schedule.
We need to alter a live orders table in production; ship a versioned, forward-only database migration instead of editing schema.sql in place.
Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline on the very first commit so pull request checks run lint and tests before anything merges.
Deploy the new checkout engine behind a feature flag for 5% canary traffic and rehearse a one-command rollback in case error rates spike.
Enforce inside one aggregate transaction boundary that an invoice's line items always equal its total and a settled state machine transition cannot be reversed.
Our User class has 90 fields shared across billing, support and shipping; split the coupled god-object into bounded contexts with clear module seams.
Half the codebase says Organization, the UI says Workspace and the tests say Tenant; establish a single ubiquitous language glossary across code and UI.
Our dialog traps mouse users fine, but keyboard tab focus disappears and VoiceOver screen reader users get no WCAG announcement when it opens.
Generated screens have twelve hardcoded hex blues and inconsistent padding; centralize colour, spacing and typography into CSS variables and design tokens.
Every dashboard page only renders the populated happy path and flashes blank white during fetch or network failure; define loading, empty state and error state views.
Keep the four-week v1 focused by writing explicit non-goals so feature requests like SSO, dark mode and custom plugins stay out of scope.
All I have is a vague one-liner pitch for a clinic scheduler; turn it into a crisp product brief stating who it helps and what they do today before coding.
Instead of building every database table first, map the primary user journey walkthrough and ship one testable end-to-end vertical slice.
Stripe delivered payment_intent.succeeded twice during a timeout retry and our worker double-charged the customer; make webhook handling idempotent.
When a checkout fails in production we cannot trace a request across workers; add structured logging with a correlation ID and error-rate alerting.
Before exposing our customer portal publicly, run a numbered OWASP ASVS security checklist hardening review instead of guessing what controls we missed.
Changing the UUID in GET /api/invoices/:id lets Organization A read Organization B's invoice; enforce deny-by-default RBAC and tenant isolation on every read.
Someone committed an AWS secret in an .env file and installed unpinned npm packages; add secret scanning and supply chain lockfile hygiene.
Map our public upload and webhook trust boundaries with a lightweight STRIDE threat model so every untrusted entry point has a named mitigation.
Every acceptance criterion needs traceability to a real test via @req anchors so nobody can mark a requirement done without test proof.
Our hand-written mock for the Twilio third-party API passed all year while production broke on a changed field; replace mocks with contract tests and real fixtures.
Line coverage on billing is 96% yet an off-by-one < vs <= bug slipped through because assertions were weak; run Stryker mutation testing to catch surviving mutants.
Three hand-picked unit examples missed a currency-split rounding bug; use fast-check property-based generative inputs to fuzz ledger invariants.
Stop letting the agent write 400 lines of implementation and bolt tests on afterward; require a failing test first in a strict red-green-refactor TDD loop.
Our CI takes 28 minutes because 90% of the test suite is flaky browser tests; rebalance the test pyramid toward fast domain tests and a small smoke budget.
Untrusted email bodies fed into our support assistant could carry prompt injection attacks that cross a trust boundary and invoke destructive tools.
SQS delivers background jobs at-least-once, so a worker crash mid-flight replays the message; make job handlers safe on retry without duplicate side effects.
Renaming a column directly broke old app pods during rolling deploy; use expand-and-contract database migrations with a safe rollback path.
Prisma query objects are leaking into every business service; apply hexagonal dependency inversion so domain rules depend only on interfaces.
New admin routes default to open unless someone remembers middleware; centralize access control permissions so unauthenticated or unauthorized roles are denied by default.
Run mutmut on our Python risk-scoring module to measure mutation score and find tests that execute code without asserting the return value.
Use Hypothesis generative testing in Python to throw random command sequences at our reservation state machine and uncover edge cases.
Export a self-contained handoff brief we can paste into Lovable or hand to an agent without explaining the repo in chat.
Audit keyboard navigation, visible focus states and ARIA labels so our form meets baseline a11y accessibility rules.
Users see a broken layout when search returns zero items or times out; model explicit loading spinner, empty state and error state transitions.
Define privacy retention rules and an automated purge for personal PII logs when a user requests account deletion.
Write an ArchUnit architecture test so any controller importing a repository directly fails CI immediately.
Test our Stripe adapter against recorded third-party API fixtures with contract tests, and make webhook retry processing idempotent against duplicate events.
Write each failing test first in a red-green-refactor TDD loop and bind every acceptance criterion to its test with an @req traceability anchor.
Standardize component colours and spacing on CSS design system tokens while ensuring WCAG keyboard focus and screen reader accessibility.
Ship the alter-table database migration forward-only and guard the release behind a canary feature flag with a rehearsed rollback.
Define the ledger aggregate consistency invariants and verify them with fast-check property-based generative testing across thousands of inputs.
Wire GitHub Actions pull request CI checks from day one and include the spec drift guard so stale specs fail the pipeline.
Write a helper function in JavaScript that sorts an array of numbers in ascending order.
Fix the typo in the copyright year string in Footer.tsx from 2025 to 2026.
Convert degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit rounded to one decimal place.
Turn a blog post title into a lowercase hyphenated URL slug.
Implement a small debounce utility wrapper around setTimeout.
Parse a comma-separated line of quoted strings into an array of cells.
Compute the nth Fibonacci number iteratively using BigInt.
Update the license badge link at the top of the markdown file.
The backend calls a buyer an Account, the checkout page calls them a Customer, and the database table says clients; enforce one agreed glossary so code and UI stop using synonyms.
Every new contributor asks why we chose SQLite over Redis and proposes a rewrite; record architectural decisions, rationale and rejected alternatives in the repo.
Tests execute every branch of the discount calculator with weak assertions, so breaking the math on purpose still leaves coverage green.
Keep third-party SDK types out of the billing domain so business rules stay framework-free and replaceable behind narrow interfaces.
Generate thousands of random inputs and edge cases to check the invariant that splitting an invoice across N diners always sums back to the exact total.
A regular member guessed another member's record ID and edited it; put one policy layer between the request and the data that tests the denial path and blocks unauthorized roles.
Ship the checkout rewrite behind a switch to internal staff first with a rehearsed rollback we can flip during an incident.
Propagate one correlation ID across structured logs and two alert metrics so we can trace failures across background workers.
AI receipt extraction pipeline must validate structured JSON output, cap token spend, and never send patient names or IBANs to OpenAI.
Blinded sponsor auditors can view anonymized trial totals while site coordinators only see patients at their own hospital site.
